item.title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
item.description: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

item.title: After court flurry, Missouri officials set aside GOP redistricting
item.description: After a flurry of court maneuvers, the Republican redistricting of U.S. House seats in Missouri is blocked. It's a win for Democrats fighting to win control of the House — but maybe not over yet.

item.title: Anti-Muslim rhetoric is finding a growing foothold in GOP messaging ahead of November
item.description: A strain of anti-Muslim bigotry has become increasingly common in GOP politics, manifesting everywhere from a "Sharia-free America" caucus in Congress to rhetoric on the campaign trail.
